_comment: Anti-nausea motion limits for every non-emergency setpoint change. All values are [MED]: to be signed off by the medical side before anybody rides. output_rpm_per_s: angular acceleration of the arm (0.25 = 12.4 motor rpm/s through i = 49.79). g_per_s: rate of change of the centripetal load. min_run_motor_rpm: slowest non-zero setpoint (55 = 1.1 output rpm). max_interval_s: longest interval one step may be paid for with.
